title: Growing into the Spirit of Revelation
summary: Following zone interviews and an update that upcoming transfers are postponed due to strict lockdown rules, President Hughes explores how to recognize personal revelation. Drawing from 1 Kings, Elder Dallin H. Oaks, and President Boyd K. Packer, he explains that spiritual communication is a still, small voice that is felt more than heard. He encourages missionaries to gauge promptings by reflecting on the peace or unrest they feel after acting on an impression.
